# Review (pass 1) — kebra-nagast-ch43

Adversarial pass on `units.json` (44 units, 0 = chapter heading) against `packet.md`, `conventions.md`, `known-forms.json` and the published parts' renderings (ch. 29, 30, 31–32, 33–34, 36, 38–39, 40, 41, 42). Dillmann unavailable, so lexical calls are hedged (?). `t` untouched by script: the joined `t` still equals the packet Geʿez character for character (3,026 characters), `p` flags unchanged (units 0 and 1), every unit ends at ። ፤ or ፨, none is over 45 words. Unit numbers are 0-based positions in `units.json`.

- 0 · n · moderate · "ch. 42 had the 3ms ተአዘዘ" is false (ch. 42 has no such form) · removed; replaced by the remark that the T stem can also mean "obey" (?).

- 5 · n · moderate · note called the sense "a guess" with no reference to the house reading · rewritten to follow ch. 38–39.

- 6 · n · minor · note offered both readings without saying which the house takes · rewritten.
- 7 · n · minor · lemma misspelled ሠይመ (it is ሠየመ), and ይትፈነዉ called "imperfect" while the gloss and i give the subjunctive ("that they be sent") · corrected.
- 14 · l, i, n · minor · ሰርዌ "host" stated flatly; I also know a ሰርዌ "creeping thing, serpent", and the gloss entry already carried (?) · (?) added; ሐራ "soldiers" in the same unit supports "host".
- 18 · n · minor · ደቅ given only as "servant, youth, disciple"; it is also the singular of ደቂቅ "sons" (unit 0) · "child-of" named as an equal possibility.
- 25 · n · minor · root misspelled ዐሰረ (should be ዐሠረ "take a tenth") and the ሰ/ሠ difference in መአስሪ not mentioned · corrected and said.
- 26 · l · minor · ሊቀ is a construct but l had "Chief" · "Chief-of Wundeyos" (i keeps "Chief Wundeyos").
- 30 · l, i · minor · ወሀቦ left its suffix -ኦ unrendered ("he-gave horses"); the note itself says it takes -ኦ and the final ወሀቦ ለወልዱ is the anticipating-suffix pattern the notes name elsewhere · "he-gave-him ... he-gave-him, to-his-son".

- 35 · i · minor · imperfects ይረግምዎ and የሐምይዎ turned to past tense though l has the present and the next units are present · "curse", "blame".

- 36 · l · moderate · ይሠረዉ: l active "they-root-out idols" while i is passive; ጣዖታት has no accusative ending, so it is the subject · l "that be-rooted-out idols (?)", n states the other reading.
- 36 · n · minor · ያገብኦን sense line brought into line with the house rendering.
- 38 · n · moderate · ያሤንዩ called "the doubled-middle stem"; it is the causative (አሠነየ), as the gloss entry says · corrected.
- 41 · i, l · moderate · the list after መንግሥትሰ ለእግዚኣብሔር was presented as apposition to the kingdom, with "he rules" left hanging; ኵላ and አጽናፈ carry the accusative ending, so the list is the object of ይኴንን · i "...and the sea and the dry land he himself rules"; l colon removed.
- 41 · n · moderate · "a list in apposition" contradicted the accusative endings the drafter's own gloss records · rewritten.
- 42 · i · moderate · i added "authority" (not in the Geʿez: ወሀቦ has only the suffix), dropped ከማሁ, and made "repay ... with evil / reward ... with good" · "he has given it, from beneath himself, that he may judge; likewise, as to those who do evil, that he repay them evil, ...".

- 9 ወአቡሁሰ ለአርኒ ... ናታን ነቢይ: the note states both readings; l is literal; i follows the note's choice; kept.
- 15, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26: unidentified titles and names, all flagged (?) in l, i and n; no better reading available without Dillmann; kept.
- 26 ሊቀ before the name and ኔልንት ዮስ split: source oddities accurately described; kept.
- 35 አንጋዲሆሙ and በሓውርቲሆሙ left as "..." (?); kept.
- 39 ይብልዎያአምሮሙ as one word: correctly described.
- 42 ሠና ፡ የ split: correctly described.
- 43 eight ፨: kept attached as in the source.
- 8: Azariah son of Zadok the priest, 1 Kings 4:2: checked; 9 Nathan the prophet and 13 recorder (2 Samuel 8:16, 1 Kings 4:3): consistent with what the text says; (1 Kings 4:2–6 is a model, not a source for the names; the note only says "model").
- 37 Genesis 22:18 (also 12:3, 26:4): l and i follow the Geʿez order; kept.

## Findings refused

- 0 i "host" for ኀይል against l "strength-of": both senses stated in n; kept.
- 3 ነበረ "sit" in i against the gloss "live": the note says "dwell and sit"; kept.
- 4 i "titles" for አስማት "names": stated in the note; kept.

- 12 note's "sons succeeding fathers" is interpretation but labelled as such; kept.

- 36 ያገብኦን "will" (future) against possible jussive "may God": cannot be settled from the form; kept as written.
- 37 i "all the nations of the earth": follows the Geʿez (ኵሎሙ አሕዛበ ምድር); only the order is shared with Genesis; kept.

# Review (pass 2) — kebra-nagast-ch43

Checked all 165 entries of `gloss.json` against the text, the (now edited) unit `l`/`i`/`n`, `known-forms.json` and the published parts' glossaries. `gloss.json` keys equal `novel-forms.json` keys (165, no stray, none missing); every word of every `t` is a gloss key or a known-forms key. `__broaden__` has 3 entries (ወከመ, ቃለ, ወሀቦ), each starting with the whole old entry from `known-forms.json` (checked by script). `t` unchanged (checked by script against the original).

## Changes (form · field · severity · what was wrong · what was done)

- ምርካቡ (unit 5) · gloss meaning · moderate · "possession, acquisition" against the house "rank, standing (?)" (ch. 38–39) · now "rank, standing ... (?)".
- ለመገብቱ (unit 6) · gloss lemma/meaning · moderate · lemma መገብት with the meaning "service, administration", against ch. 29 and 38–39 (lemma መጋቢ, "stewards (?)") · lemma መጋቢ, "for his stewards (?)".

- ተአዘዙ (unit 0) · gloss · minor · "obey" not mentioned · added (?).
- ሰርዌ (unit 14) · gloss · minor · lemma sense unhedged beyond (?) · alternative "creeping thing, serpent" stated.
- ቤት (unit 17) · gloss · minor · "ቤት here in መልህቀ ቤት" pinned the entry to the line · general entry.
- ደቀ (unit 18) · gloss · minor · "servant, follower, disciple" only; ደቅ is the singular of ደቂቅ · "child, youth, servant".

- ያገብኦን (unit 36) · gloss · minor · "bring back, restore, hand over" · reordered to the house "hand over, bring back".

- The known entry ይኴንን "he rule, judge" (typo for "he rules") and ሀገርሰ "the city indeed" are published-part entries; not touched (a broaden is not needed for a typo; ሀገር "city, land" in the new entry covers the use).
- ተአዘዙ lemma አዘዘ rather than ተአዘዘ: same practice as ተሰምዩ / ተውህቡ in published parts (base verb, T-stem stated in the parse); kept.
- ኀየሰ, ያሤንዩ, ትኄሊ, ወየሐምይዎ, ወአንጋዲሆሙ, ወበሓውርቲሆሙ, ሕዘቢሆሙ, ዘአንገሠ: cannot be improved without Dillmann; hedges are honest; kept.
- ጸዋሬ "ጸዋሪ ... bearer" (ጸውረ not checkable): kept with the note's hedge.
- ተደለዉ "ተደለወ be ready": kept.
- All lemma spellings of the divine name: እግዚኣብሔር as in the book's known entries; kept.
